criteria: Valid inline Python verification commands do not produce stale-path warnings from their source text, including when interpreter flags are present.
Actual missing path operands after inline source and in subsequent shell commands still produce warnings; existing paths do not.
Add regression coverage demonstrating the defect before the production fix and passing afterward.
cases.description: Task pickup briefs sometimes flag valid verification commands as stale when a command runs Python inline and the source contains path-like strings. Investigate the path scanner and correct the false positives while retaining useful warnings about missing command operands. Preserve ordinary script and shell-command path handling.
cases.summary: Prevent false stale-path warnings for inline Python verification commands

criteria: Generated Python and pytest cache directories are cleaned at nested project depths so otherwise clean task worktrees can be removed.
Unrelated files, similarly named directories, symlinks, and external targets remain intact.
Unknown untracked leftovers still prevent non-forced Git worktree removal.
Add regression coverage demonstrating the defect before the production fix and passing afterward.
cases.description: Task-worktree cleanup can fail after successful tests because Python and pytest leave generated cache directories inside nested projects. Extend the existing generated-cache cleanup to support those locations. Preserve the safety boundary: user files and similarly named directories must remain protected, symlinks must not cause deletion outside the worktree, and unknown leftovers must still prevent ordinary worktree removal.
cases.summary: Allow safe task-worktree cleanup after tests create nested Python caches
